page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew lexicon entries. Left column: entries from R. הלל to R. תור. Right column: entries from יתילדו to יתלו. Printed page number top left, Hebrew letter running head top centre of each column. No notes in margins, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.l: R. הָלַל, in Piel, הִלֵּל, vel הלל.
וַיִּתֵּן & signavit, fut. Piel, 3. sing. m. apoc. (pro יְהַוֶּה,) Rad. הָוָה.
יָהֻדּוּ confitebuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. (pro יִתְיַדּוּ,) Rad. יָדָה jecit.
יִתּוֹכַּח disceptabit, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. (pro יִתְּוַכַּח,) Rad. יָכַח.
יִתּוֹם absolvetur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יָתוֹם, Rad. תָּמַם.
יְתוֹמֶיךָ pupilli tui, pl. m. aff. No. Rad. f. m. יָתוֹם pupillus.
יִתֵּן diruet, pro יִתֵּין, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָתַן.
יָתוֹר excellens vel explo-ratio, f. m. constr. No. יָתוֹר, à R. יָתַר, vel No. f. m. R. תּוֹר.
וַיִּתְחַל & aegrotum egit, fut Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. pro יִתְחַלֶּה; Rad. חָלָה.
יִתְיַלְּדוּ natales profitebuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָלַד.
יִתְיַעֲצוּ consultabunt, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. יָעַץ.
יִתְיַצְּבוּ sistent se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. יָצַב.
וַיִּתְיָרוּ & explorarunt caraverunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. תּוּר.
וַיִּתְּכוּ & effusi sunt, & effuderunt, fut. Kal, & Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָתַךְ.
יִתְּכוֹן stabilietur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. כּוּן.
יִתָּכֵן aptabitur, יִתְּכְנוּ aptabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. תָּכַן.
תִּתְכַּסֶּה & texit se, tegent se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִתְכַּסֶּה,) & 3. pl. m. R. כָּסָה.
יִתְלוּ suspendent, fut. Kal, וַיִּתְלוּ & suspensi sunt, fut.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some dagesh marks are small and partly blurred on the scan; the Hebrew forms above are a best reading and may contain errors where the points are unclear. The left-column first entry's Hebrew heading and the page number "302" are slightly blurred; the page number may be 302 or 304. Running head is the Hebrew letter ח in each column header, not a title. Entries are set as dictionary lines, so each entry is given as one line.
